title: Taiwan's Economy Grows 14.36%, the Fastest in 48 Years
summaryZh: 台灣第三季經濟成長14.36%，創48年新高
summaryHi: ताइवान की अर्थव्यवस्था तीसरी तिमाही में 14.36% बढ़ी, 48 साल में सबसे तेज़
summaryEs: La economía de Taiwán creció un 14,36 % en el tercer trimestre, el mayor ritmo en 48 años
summaryJa: 台湾の7～9月期GDP成長率は14.36％、48年ぶりの高さ
summaryEn: Taiwan's economy grew 14.36% in the third quarter, the fastest pace in 48 years.
paragraphs: Taiwan's economy expanded by 14.36% year on year in the third quarter, its strongest showing for that period in 48 years, the Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS) announced on Friday.
The new estimate is 2.94 percentage points higher than the agency's August forecast, and it marks the fourth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth.

DGBAS official Chiang Hsin-yi said exports and business investment had both beaten expectations. Global demand for chips used in artificial intelligence, high-performance computing and cloud services stayed strong, and higher export prices lifted the value of shipments. Investment rose by about 26%, while imports of capital equipment jumped 58.5%.

Domestic demand also held up. Private consumption grew 5.37% in real terms, supported by a recovering car market and the so-called wealth effect, as share prices hit record highs. Chiang added that exports outside the technology sector were also growing quickly, a sign that traditional industries are slowly recovering.
Growth for the first nine months of the year is now estimated at 14.22%, the highest for that period in half a century.
Taiwan's economy is growing very fast. The government gave new numbers on Friday.
From July to September, the economy was 14.36% bigger than one year before. This is the best result for these months in 48 years.
Why? Other countries are buying many Taiwanese computer parts. They need these parts for AI and for big data centres. Companies in Taiwan are also buying new machines.
People in Taiwan are spending more money too. More people are buying cars. Share prices are very high, so many families feel richer.
This is the fourth time in a row that growth is over 10%. The last long time like this was in 1986 and 1987.
sentZh: 台灣的經濟成長得非常快。
政府在星期五公布了新的數字。
從七月到九月，經濟規模比一年前大了14.36%。
這是48年來這幾個月最好的成績。
為什麼呢？
其他國家正在大量購買台灣的電腦零件。
他們需要這些零件來發展AI和大型資料中心。
台灣的公司也在購買新機器。
台灣人也花更多錢了。
買車的人變多了。
股價非常高，所以很多家庭覺得自己變有錢了。
這是成長率連續第四次超過10%。
上一次像這樣持續很久，是在1986年和1987年。

paragraphs: Taiwan's economy has grown at its fastest pace in almost half a century, according to new figures from the government's statistics office.
The office says the economy grew 14.36% in the third quarter of the year, compared with the same period last year. This is almost three points higher than the office expected in August.

The main reason is strong exports. Around the world, companies want Taiwanese electronic parts for artificial intelligence, powerful computers and cloud services. At the same time, Taiwanese firms are investing a lot in new equipment. Imports of machines for making computer chips rose by about 36%.
Shoppers are helping as well. Spending by households rose more than 5%, partly because car sales recovered. Record-high share prices have also made many people feel wealthier.
It is the fourth quarter in a row with growth above 10%. An official said the last similar period was in 1986 and 1987. Growth for the first nine months is now about 14%.
sentZh: 根據政府統計機關公布的新數據，台灣經濟以將近半世紀以來最快的速度成長。
該機關表示，今年第三季經濟比去年同期成長14.36%。
這比該機關八月時的預期高出將近三個百分點。
主要原因是出口強勁。
世界各地的公司都想要台灣的電子零件，用於人工智慧、高效能電腦和雲端服務。
同時，台灣企業也大量投資新設備。
製造電腦晶片的機器進口成長了約36%。
消費者也有幫助。
家庭支出成長超過5%，部分原因是汽車銷售回溫。
創紀錄的股價也讓許多人覺得自己更富有。
這是連續第四季成長超過10%。
一位官員表示，上一次類似的時期是在1986年和1987年。
今年前九個月的成長率目前約為14%。

paragraphs: Taiwan's economy expanded by 14.36% year on year in the third quarter, its strongest showing for that period in 48 years, the Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS) announced on Friday.
The new estimate is 2.94 percentage points higher than the agency's August forecast, and it marks the fourth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth.

DGBAS official Chiang Hsin-yi said exports and business investment had both beaten expectations. Global demand for chips used in artificial intelligence, high-performance computing and cloud services stayed strong, and higher export prices lifted the value of shipments. Investment rose by about 26%, while imports of capital equipment jumped 58.5%.

Domestic demand also held up. Private consumption grew 5.37% in real terms, supported by a recovering car market and the so-called wealth effect, as share prices hit record highs. Chiang added that exports outside the technology sector were also growing quickly, a sign that traditional industries are slowly recovering.
Growth for the first nine months of the year is now estimated at 14.22%, the highest for that period in half a century.
sentZh: 行政院主計總處星期五宣布，台灣第三季經濟年增14.36%，是48年來同期最強勁的表現。
新的估計值比該機關八月的預測高出2.94個百分點，也是連續第四季出現兩位數成長。
主計總處專門委員江心怡表示，出口和企業投資都優於預期。
全球對用於人工智慧、高效能運算和雲端服務的晶片需求依然強勁，出口價格上揚也推升了出貨價值。
投資成長約26%，資本設備進口則大增58.5%。
內需也維持穩健。
民間消費實質成長5.37%，受惠於汽車市場回溫以及股價創新高所帶來的所謂財富效果。
江心怡補充說，科技業以外的出口也快速成長，顯示傳統產業正在慢慢復甦。
今年前九個月的經濟成長率目前估計為14.22%，是半世紀以來同期最高。

paragraphs: Taiwan's economic boom shows no sign of fading. According to the Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS), gross domestic product rose 14.36% year on year in the third quarter, the most robust third-quarter performance since the late 1970s.
The figure surpassed the agency's own August projection by 2.94 percentage points and extends an unbroken run of double-digit quarterly growth to four.

Officials attributed the upside surprise chiefly to exports and capital spending. Insatiable global appetite for components powering artificial intelligence, high-performance computing and cloud infrastructure, together with rising export prices, inflated the value of overseas sales. Meanwhile, real investment climbed roughly 26%, and imports of capital equipment surged 58.5%, with semiconductor machinery alone up almost 36%.

Consumers, too, played their part. Real private consumption advanced 5.37%, buoyed by a rebound in car purchases and a wealth effect stemming from record stock prices. Encouragingly, non-tech exports also posted double-digit gains, hinting at a gradual revival in traditional manufacturing.
Analysts note that Taiwan last enjoyed such a prolonged spell of rapid expansion in 1986 and 1987, when capital and currency controls were being relaxed.
sentZh: 台灣的經濟熱潮絲毫沒有降溫的跡象。
根據行政院主計總處，第三季國內生產毛額年增14.36%，是1970年代末以來最強勁的第三季表現。
這個數字比該機關自己八月的預測高出2.94個百分點，也讓連續兩位數的季度成長延長到四季。
官員將這次超乎預期的表現主要歸功於出口和資本支出。
全球對驅動人工智慧、高效能運算和雲端基礎設施之零組件的需求永無止盡，加上出口價格上漲，推高了海外銷售的價值。
同時，實質投資攀升約26%，資本設備進口激增58.5%，光是半導體機器就成長將近36%。
消費者也發揮了作用。
實質民間消費成長5.37%，受到購車回溫以及股價創紀錄所帶來之財富效果的支撐。
令人振奮的是，非科技類出口也有兩位數成長，暗示傳統製造業正逐漸復甦。
分析師指出，台灣上一次享有如此長時間的快速擴張是在1986年和1987年，當時資本和外匯管制正在放寬。

paragraphs: Taiwan's economy is currently expanding at a pace not witnessed for nearly five decades. Official statistics released on Friday indicate that gross domestic product grew by 14.36% year on year in the third quarter, the strongest third-quarter result in 48 years.
Notably, the estimate exceeded the government's own August forecast by almost three percentage points, and it represents the fourth consecutive quarter in which growth has surpassed 10%.

The principal driver remains the global artificial intelligence boom. Overseas demand for Taiwanese chips and servers used in data processing and cloud computing has proved remarkably resilient, while higher export prices have further inflated earnings. Simultaneously, domestic firms have invested heavily in production capacity, with imports of capital equipment rising by 58.5%.

Household spending has also contributed, increasing by 5.37% as car sales recovered and soaring share prices generated a perceptible wealth effect. Moreover, exports beyond the technology sector have achieved double-digit growth, suggesting that traditional industries are beginning to revive.
Nevertheless, some economists caution that such dependence on a single sector leaves the island vulnerable should global investment in artificial intelligence slow.
sentZh: 台灣經濟目前正以近五十年來未見的速度擴張。
星期五公布的官方統計顯示，第三季國內生產毛額年增14.36%，是48年來最強勁的第三季成績。
值得注意的是，這個估計值比政府自己八月的預測高出將近三個百分點，而且是成長率連續第四季超過10%。
主要的推動力仍是全球人工智慧熱潮。
海外對台灣用於資料處理和雲端運算之晶片與伺服器的需求展現出驚人的韌性，而出口價格上漲又進一步推高了收益。
同時，國內企業大舉投資產能，資本設備進口成長了58.5%。
家庭支出也有貢獻，隨著汽車銷售回溫以及股價飆漲帶來明顯的財富效果，成長了5.37%。
此外，科技業以外的出口也達到兩位數成長，顯示傳統產業開始復甦。
不過，一些經濟學家提醒，如此依賴單一產業，萬一全球對人工智慧的投資放緩，台灣將容易受到衝擊。
